description: Defines a custom Flutter widget 'PressableScale' that provides a press animation effect by scaling its child widget when pressed. It manages gesture detection and animated scaling influenced by motion reduction settings.

classes.name: PressableScale
classes.description: A customizable tappable widget that scales its child when pressed, with support for border radius and pressed scale factor.

classes.name: _PressableScaleState
classes.description: The internal state class managing press detection and animation for 'PressableScale'.

methods.name: _setPressed
methods.description: Updates the pressed state and triggers a rebuild.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including gesture detection, animated scaling, and clipping.
